goldens.comment: The reader thread isn’t waited for; flipping deletedAll to true and asserting immediately can race and miss exceptions added just after the flag change, making this test flaky.
goldens.reasoning: C1 describes the same race: the reader thread is never joined before the assertion runs.

candidates: tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/tests/admin/group/GroupTest.java:139 - The test checks for errors before the reader thread has finished.. The reader thread is started but never kept or joined. Right after the last delete, the main thread sets `deletedAll` and runs `assertThat(caughtExceptions, empty())` straight away. The reader can still be inside a `groups(...)` call at that moment, so an exception from that last read (the one most likely to hit a deleted group) is added after the assertion has already passed. The test can then pass even though the NPE still happens. Keep a reference to the `Thread` and call `join()` (with a timeout) after `deletedAll.set(true)` and before the assertion. This also stops the thread from outliving the test.
